scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --outdir dist --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version)
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: _SENTRY_RELEASE=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli releases new $_SENTRY_RELEASE --org=awana-digital --project=comapeo-metrics-worker && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=awana-digital --project=comapeo-events-worker --release=$_SENTRY_RELEASE --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist
